about: His courtship-song circuit, cut from the Janelia male CNS connectome v0.9 (brain + nerve cord of one male; Berg et al. 2025). Seeds: LC10a (seeing her), vAB3 (tasting her), P1, the song descending neurons pIP10, pMP2, DNp36 (pIP9), the song premotor neurons (vPR6, dPR1, TN1a, vMS12, Lillvis et al. 2024 types) and the wing motor neurons; plus the strongest links between successive stages. Edges: synapse counts >= 5 (minconf 0.5). Signs: predicted transmitter (ACh +, GABA -, Glu -; others +0.3).
